question: Which customer has the highest average monthly change in payment amounts? Provide the customer's full name.
sql:
-- Final query: customer with highest average monthly change in payment amounts (absolute value)
WITH monthly_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', payment_date) AS payment_month,
        SUM(amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_total,
        monthly_total - LAG(monthly_total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) AS month_change
    FROM monthly_payments
)
SELECT 
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    AVG(ABS(mc.month_change)) AS avg_abs_monthly_change
FROM monthly_changes mc
JOIN customer c ON mc.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE mc.month_change IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.first_name, c.last_name
ORDER BY avg_abs_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1
